Name: (CP) Seasonal Portrait Backgrounds
Author: GalaxyRobotMods
Description:
[center][size=1]Yes, this is a new version of my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32607]Living Portraits[/url]﻿. If you're interested in why I deleted it, check the comments.[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/m0Lfzhm.png[/img]﻿
I never liked the character backgrounds; they looked like old, worn parchment. That's why I made this mod!

[b]Seasonal Portrait Background[/b] replaces the default portrait backdrop with dynamic backgrounds that reflect the world around each character. Instead of a static texture, portraits now adapt based on location, season, and time of day.
[color=#ff0000]
[/color][color=#ff0000][b]This mod does NOT edit, redraw, or replace any character portraits.[/b][/color]
It only modifies the background layer behind the characters. The portrait artwork itself remains completely untouched.
Because of this, the mod is fully compatible with:
- Portrait redesign mods
- HD portrait packs
- Seasonal outfit mods
- Custom NPC portrait mods[list]
[/list][b]As long as a mod does not remove the portrait background layer entirely, compatibility should be seamless.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BIE8BBZ.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/XOapBQi.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/5xtamgF.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿

[b][size=5][color=#38761d]FUTURE MOD UPDATES[/color]
[/size][/b]- Weather backgrounds (Rain, green rain, wind)
- Improved customization of farmhouse backgrounds
- Added support for Stardew Valley Expanded
- Support for recolor mods (Earthy UI, for example)

[color=#c27ba0][size=3]A [/size][size=5]❤[/size][size=3] for you if you have downloaded my mod.
Feel free to comment whatever you want, I will surely answer :3[/size][/color]
